title: ReMoE: An Interpretable Mixture-of-Experts Framework for Human Mobility Recovery Forecasting Across Disasters
abstract: arXiv:2611.22133v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Human mobility often declines sharply following disasters and subsequently exhibits complex recovery dynamics. Effective forecasting of this recovery is critical for timely assessment and resource allocation. However, existing approaches are often developed for individual events and operate as black boxes, limiting their transferability and interpretability beyond the events they were trained on. Recent studies have identified recurring post-disaster mobility recovery types across disasters, suggesting that recovery knowledge may be transferable. Motivated by this, we propose ReMoE, an interpretable mixture-of-experts framework for cross-disaster mobility recovery forecasting. ReMoE uses a feature-guided router to adaptively combine specialized experts that learn these heterogeneous yet reusable recovery types, producing a region-specific recovery pattern. It further refines this pattern through residual correction informed by forecasts

translated_title: ReMoE：一个用于跨灾害人类流动性恢复预测的可解释混合专家框架
translated_abstract: 灾害发生后，人类流动性往往会急剧下降，随后表现出复杂的恢复动态。有效预测这种恢复过程对于及时的灾情评估和资源分配至关重要。然而，现有方法通常针对单个事件开发，且以黑盒方式运行，限制了其在训练事件之外的迁移性和可解释性。近期研究已识别出跨灾害中反复出现的灾后流动性恢复类型，表明恢复知识可能是可迁移的。受此启发，我们提出了ReMoE，一个用于跨灾害流动性恢复预测的可解释混合专家框架。ReMoE使用特征引导的路由器，自适应地组合专门学习这些异构但可复用恢复类型的专家，从而生成特定区域的恢复模式。它还进一步通过基于预测的残差校正来细化该恢复模式。
tldr: 提出了ReMoE，一个可解释的混合专家框架，通过特征引导的路由器自适应组合学习异构且可复用恢复类型的专家，实现跨灾害场景下的人类流动性恢复预测。
en_tdlr: We propose ReMoE, an interpretable mixture-of-experts framework that uses a feature-guided router to adaptively combine experts learning heterogeneous yet reusable recovery types, enabling cross-disaster human mobility recovery forecasting.
